name: Shanghai Fortune Techgroup Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Fortune Techgroup Co., Ltd. provides semiconductor products and solutions in China and internationally. The company engages in the distribution, application design and technological innovation of wireless communication, low-power main control SoC chips and sensor components. It also provides wired and wireless communications, radio frequency and power amplifier type of components, sensors, and others; speakers, receiver, microphones, VCM, lens, and LDS antenna; antenna; MCU; thermal solution; and gas gauge, battery protection, power management, and USB power/protection IC.
